items.title: There is no ‘now’ in a distributed system
Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.blurb: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

items.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
Beyond API Compatibility: Building a Tool to Measure the Blast Radius of Library Changes
Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
items.blurb: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.
